body.Job title: Experienced Bubble.io Developer for Mobile Client Portal (Figma Mockup Ready)
body.Job description: Job Description We are looking for a skilled Bubble.io developer to build a secure, mobile-first web app for our clients. The application will be accessed primarily on smartphones via physical QR code scans on magnets. We have a complete, interactive Figma prototype ready to review. Your job will be translating this design into a fully functioning, responsive Bubble app with database privacy controls and automated real-time data exports. Design Reference Figma Interactive Prototype: https://www.figma.com/make/5mcLRrfdVs1NbBNWdWsRrJ/Client-Access-QR-Code?fullscreen=1&t=k7rL9ejxsFGY4J5a-1&code-node-id=0-6 **Front-end UI build in Bubble.io must visually match the layouts, colors, and button placements established in the Figma design across mobile Safari and Chrome.** Core User Workflows & App Architecture 1. Passcode Gate & Security: * User lands on the app via QR scan containing a secret URL parameter. * SEO blocking (`noindex` & `robots.txt`) configured to keep the app hidden from search engines. * Client logs in by entering a **4-letter passcode** (the first 4 letters of their street address). * Verified against a client database table before unlocking the main dashboard. 2. Main Menu (4 Action Buttons): Button 1: Order / Refill Prescription Button 2: Request Documents Button 3: Instructions, How-to, Procedures (Secondary menu displaying viewable/(non-downloadable) PDF documents). Button 4: Clinical After Hours Support - Form submission "Tap to Call" phone link if field are filled out and recorded in .csv 3. Data Pipeline (Google Sheets / CSV Sync): All form submissions across Prescription Refills, Document Requests, and After-Hours Support must automatically update a live **Google Sheet** (or generate an exportable CSV dataset via Bubble Backend Workflows) in real time or hourly. Developer Responsibilities Translate provided Figma layouts into responsive Bubble pages using the modern Flexbox engine. Set up database architecture, relationships, and strict Data Privacy Rules Privacy to prevent unauthorized web scraping/browser inspection. Implement address passcode authentication logic and telephone protocols. Set up real-time Google Sheets / CSV sync via plugins or scheduled backend workflows. Conduct end-to-end testing across mobile iOS Safari and Android Chrome. --- Project Structure & Payment This project will be managed via Fixed-Price Milestones: 1. **Milestone 1:** Database Architecture, Passcode Auth & Security/SEO Lockdown (Database Architecture, Security & Authentication, setup database schema & client tables, build address passcode authentication logic, configure noindex SEO shielding & Data Privacy Rules) -25% of budget allocation 2. **Milestone 2:** Responsive UI Build (Figma Implementation) & Navigation (Translate Figma wireframe screens into Bubble. build Passcode Gate, 4-Button Main Menu, PDF viewer, & submenus. Mobile responsive layout testing (iOS & Android). -25% of budget allocation 3. **Milestone 3:** Form Workflows, Google Sheets / CSV Data Pipeline & Click-to-Call (Forms, Real-Time Data Pipeline & Call Triggers, Build input forms for Prescription Refills, Documents, & After-Hours, Configure real-time Google Sheets / CSV backend sync, Set up "Tap to Call" phone action for after-hours care.) -25% budget allocation 4. **Milestone 4:** Mobile QA Testing, Bug Fixes & App Transfer -25% budget allocation Total Project Fixed Price: $1000.00 (CAD)
